units: Ber. IX, 3. Sifra introd. לידון בדבר ח׳ in order to be defined by a new point (not included in the general law); a. fr.—Esp. הֶחָ׳ or חָ׳ the new produces of the field not permitted for use before the Omer day (Lev. XXIII, 10—14).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:9">Kidd. I, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Kiddushin 37a:8">37ᵃ</cite>) <cite ref="A02595"><he>אף</he></cite> (<he>מןּ</he>) <he>הח׳</he> also with the exception of the new produces (the law concerning which applies even to foreign countries). Ib. 39ᵃ <he>תני ח׳</he> read ‘the new fruit’ (leaving out ‘also’).
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 4:7">Dem. IV, 7</cite> <he>שלי ח׳ הוא</he> mine is new fruit (not yet permitted); a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲדָשִׁים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 2:4">Yoma II, 4</cite> <he>ח׳ לקטורת בֹּאוּ</he> new men for offering incense (such as never before have performed that function), come and &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ גם ישנים</he> new men and also old ones (who have officiated before this).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:11">Lev. R. s. 2</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:14">Cant. VII, 14</cite>) <he>ח׳</he> the later leaders, opp. to <he>ישנים</he> the patriarchs; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="H00220"><he>חֲדָשָׁה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>תורה ח׳</he> a new law, expl. <he>חִדּוּשׁ תורה</he> a novel interpretation of the law (concerning slaughtering). Pesik. Baḥod., p. 102ᵃ <he>פרוזדוגמא ח׳</he> a recent decree; a. fr.
